title: Add server-side (callable) input validation to `st.text_input`
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Extend the existing `validate` parameter of `st.text_input` to also accept a **callable** for server-side validation, executed on the backend when the value is submitted. When validation fails, the input shows an error state with a message and the value is **not** committed (no rerun). Client-side regex validation (`str` / `(regex, message)` tuple) is already implemented and shipped; this issue tracks the remaining **server-side** part of the approved [product spec](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/specs/2025-12-03-text-input-validation/product-spec.md).

### Why?

Client-side regex validation gives instant feedback but can be bypassed and can't express checks that need backend resources (e.g. database lookups) or must be secure. Server-side callable validation covers those cases — username availability, complex business logic, and security-sensitive validation — without the developer having to manually track/display errors or trigger extra reruns.

### How?

Widen the `validate` type to also accept a callable:

```python
st.text_input(
    ...,
    validate: str | tuple[str, str] | Callable[[str], bool | str] | None = None,
    #                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ NEW (callable)
)
```

The callable is executed on the backend on submit (Enter/blur/form submit) via a deferred-execution pattern (like `st.download_button` with callable data), without a full rerun. It returns `True` (valid), `False` (generic error), or a `str` (custom error message):

```python
def check_username(value: str) -> bool | str:
    if len(value) < 3:
        return "Username must be at least 3 characters."
    if db.username_exists(value):
        return "Username already taken."
    return True

st.text_input("Username", validate=check_username)
```

Key behaviors (from the spec):
- Runs on commit (blur/Enter/form submit), not on initial render; error state clears as the user types.
- Empty string / `None` bypasses validation (requiredness stays a separate future `required` parameter).
- On success: the deferred commit goes through and triggers the normal rerun / `on_change`. On failure: error state, no rerun.
- While validating: loading spinner, submit disabled, 10s timeout, in-progress validation cancelled if the user edits the value.
- Non-`bool`/`str` return or a raised exception → value rejected with a generic error; exception + traceback logged to the backend console (not sent to the frontend).
- Forms: validation runs on form submit (client-side regex first, then callables); all fields must pass before the single submit rerun.

### Additional Context

- Approved product spec: [`specs/2025-12-03-text-input-validation/product-spec.md`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/specs/2025-12-03-text-input-validation/product-spec.md) (client-side portion already shipped; this issue covers the server-side callable).
- Future extensions noted in the spec: server-side callable validation for `st.text_area`, `st.column_config.TextColumn`, `st.number_input`, `st.date_input`, `st.selectbox`, and `st.chat_input`.
